subject: Request: Availability adjustment & invoice amendment after Dec 15 outage
content:
From: Lynne Park <l.park@sigmahealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: procure@sigmahealth.com
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Availability impact on Dec 15 — request for invoice amendment

Hi Soojin,

We saw a significant degradation of Redwood inference availability between 02:07–05:22 UTC on Dec 15 that impacted our production pipelines. Engineers measured failed request rates and retry storms; our internal monitoring shows reduced throughput for that 3-hour window and increased latencies.

Please can Redwood confirm the availability percentage you record for our org for Dec 15 and provide the SLA credit calculation you will apply? We need the number and an invoice amendment / credit memo that we can apply against the December invoice. Our procurement team (procure@sigmahealth.com) is cc'd for the billing details.

Specific asks:
- Confirm availability and how it was computed (time-weighted, affected regions).
- Show the credit amount and a short calculation we can attach to our procurement record.
- Timeline for issuing a credit memo or invoice adjustment.

Thanks,
Lynne Park
Director, Platform Ops
Sigma Health
---

On Fri, 18 Dec 2027 at 10:02 AM, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai> wrote:
To: Lynne Park <l.park@sigmahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2027 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Availability impact on Dec 15 — request for invoice amendment

Lynne — thanks for the note and very sorry for the disruption. We saw the same incident in our monitoring and have an active post-incident task tracking root cause and mitigation.

Short answer: we can provide the availability calculation and produce either a credit memo or invoice amendment. I'll run the official calculation and loop in Marissa (account lead) and Evelyn (CS) to confirm the dollar impact and the issuance path.

Next steps from our side:
1) I'll pull the customer-specific availability window and metric exports and attach our uptime report.
2) Marissa will prepare a credit calculation (method and proposed amount).
3) Evelyn will confirm the timing and whether we issue a credit memo or apply an adjustment on the next invoice.

I'll follow up with the detailed numbers by Monday EOD.

— Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

-----Original message-----
> From: Lynne Park <l.park@sigmahealth.com>
> Sent: Fri, 18 Dec 2027 09:12 AM
> Subject: Availability impact on Dec 15 — request for invoice amendment


On Sat, 19 Dec 2027 at 14:20, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai> wrote:
To: Lynne Park <l.park@sigmahealth.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 19 Dec 2027 14:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Availability impact on Dec 15 — request for invoice amendment

Hi Lynne — thanks for raising this. Attached are the raw exports and our working spreadsheet: uptime_report_20271215-16.csv (per-minute availability for your org) and credit_calc_v1.xlsx (calculation steps).

Summary of approach (short):
- SLA baseline: 99.9% monthly availability per contract.
- Measurement window: UTC 2027-12-15 02:00–06:00 (includes buffer for retries and propagated errors).
- Observed availability for affected day: 99.148% for the 24-hour period containing the incident.
- Per SLA table, availability band 99.0–99.5% => 0.75% service credit; availability 99.5–99.9% => 0.25% credit. Given our measured 99.148% we map to the 0.75% band.

Calculation (rounded):
- December monthly bill (recurring inference subscription portion): $600,000
- 0.75% credit => $4,500 credit applied to December invoice.

Notes and assumptions:
- We prorated based on monthly recurring inference charges only (as specified in the SLA). Non-recurring professional services were excluded.
- We used customer-region weighting for your primary region in us-west-2 where the majority of traffic served.
- The credit is a one-off remediation for the Dec 15 outage window; we will not change historical bills beyond issuing a credit memo or invoice amendment.

Next steps:
1) Finance approval (Michael Grant) — asking for sign-off to issue a credit memo for $4,500.
2) Procurement — please confirm the billing contact and if you prefer a credit memo or a netted invoice adjustment.
3) Ops — we will attach the incident summary (incident-summary-15dec.pdf) for your records.

If you want us to break down the minute-level data in the attached CSV into a shorter one-page summary for procurement, we can do that.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: uptime_report_20271215-16.csv]
[Attachment: credit_calc_v1.xlsx]

On Tue, 21 Dec 2027 at 15:04, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai> wrote:
To: Lynne Park <l.park@sigmahealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>, procure@sigmahealth.com
Date: Tue, 21 Dec 2027 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Availability impact on Dec 15 — request for invoice amendment

Hi Lynne — following Marissa's calc, Finance has provisionally approved the credit memo. Michael confirmed on the budget side and requested a short note with the final PO/billing contact to include on the credit memo.

Action items for Sigma Health:
- Confirm preferred billing contact (name, email) or PO number to reference on the credit memo.
- Indicate whether you prefer a separate credit memo PDF (we can provide immediately) or a netted $4,500 adjustment on the Jan invoice.

What we will provide:
- Credit memo PDF with the calculation summary and attachment links to the uptime CSV and incident summary.
- A short one-page calculation that your procurement team can file with the PO.

Target timeline:
- If you confirm billing details by EOD Wed 2027-12-22, we will issue the credit memo by Thu 2027-12-23 and the credit will appear on your next statement.

Apologies again for the incident; our infra team has applied mitigations and we will share the full postmortem when it's ready (link above).

Best regards,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: incident-summary-15dec.pdf]
